definitions.explanation: A respectful way to refer to the Buddha or Buddhist deities. The さま suffix adds reverence.
A respectful, euphemistic way to refer to a person who has died. Rooted in the Buddhist belief that the deceased becomes a buddha. Common in conversation about funerals and death.

examples.japanese: {仏様|ほとけさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: I pressed my hands together in prayer to the Buddha.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仏様|ほとけさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}えていた→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother offered tea to the Buddha at the household altar every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧{時|とき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仏様|ほとけさま}{頼|だの}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧。
examples.english: It's too late to pray to Buddha only when you're in trouble.

examples.japanese: {仏様|ほとけさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧だった。
examples.english: The face of the deceased looked very peaceful.

examples.japanese: {仏様|ほとけさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手向|たむ}けた。
examples.english: I offered flowers to the deceased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧、{仏様|ほとけさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: At the funeral, time was set aside to share memories of the deceased.

notes:
USAGE:
The plain form ⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧ exists but {仏様|ほとけさま} is far more common in spoken language due to the reverence associated with both meanings. In sense 2, it is a gentler alternative to direct words for death.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese Buddhism, it is believed that the deceased become buddhas, which is why the same word is used for both meanings. This connection shapes many Japanese funeral customs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仏様|ほとけさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧ (to pray to Buddha)
- {仏様|ほとけさま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拝|おが}む→拝む：00328_ogamu⟧ (to worship Buddha)
- {仏様|ほとけさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a person as kind as Buddha — an extremely kind person)
